propositions: Define and retain a documentation ownership policy in docs/documentation-policy.md covering eight documentation roles: tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence, each with audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, citations, correction method, and examples.
Restore approved writing rules and protected forms sections from historical policy without introducing deterministic character, word, punctuation, paragraph, or prose validators or enforcement gates.

Relocate generated and parity-gated artifact inventory tables from docs/README.md to docs/generated-artifacts.md and maintain all existing catalog consumers in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py.
Restore pre-F01 descriptions for docs/cli-reference.md, server.json, criteria_routing.json, and reviewer-prompt catalog rows in the generated-artifacts inventory.

Establish concise policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md that link to the documentation ownership, correction, and writing guidance policy without describing guidance as a deterministic gate.
Preserve ticket events as append-only and ADR decision substance through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement without erasing historical evidence or protected forms.
